name: GenieX Provider
description: On-device inference on Qualcomm Snapdragon via GenieX

providerAuthChoices.cliDescription: GenieX API key (only needed behind an authenticating proxy)

models.description: Per-model load settings, keyed by "name" or "name:precision". A bare name applies to every precision of that model.

compute.description: Compute unit to request. qairt models ignore this and always run on the NPU; only llama_cpp (GGUF) models offer a choice.

contextSize.description: llama_cpp context size (nctx). Ignored by qairt models.

gpuLayers.description: llama_cpp layers to offload (ngl): 0 = pure CPU, -1 = all layers. Ignored by qairt models.

specDraftModel.description: Draft model (org/repo[:precision]) for MTP speculative decoding. Enables spec_type draft-mtp. Must already be pulled; llama_cpp and text-only.

specDraftTokens.description: Max draft tokens per verification step (spec_n_max). GenieX default is 3.

specDraftPMin.description: Draft stops proposing below this confidence (spec_p_min), between 0 and 1.

includeModels.description: Model ids to keep in the chat catalog even if they match the embedding-model name patterns.
